The most advanced and quickly developed 3D-models and their stereoscopic presentation are emphasized. The implementation is done within the context of object oriented design in the automated system of the OCM survey support.

articleTitle: Possibility of individual professional risk evaluation by means of simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2002 IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICAIS 2002)
abstract: With the help of methods and resources of simulation modeling one of the solutions of task of evaluation of individual professional risk was obtained. Using the designed technique it is possible to unite the standardized hygienic classification of working conditions and legitimacy of circadian cycles processes in human's organism which were found in biorythmologicals researches. As a metric of an evaluation of individual professional risk the level of a life resources in human's organism was analyzed (this level testifies to a stability reserve of the biosystem to an environment and the probability of manifestation in the biosystem of external extreme effect). For the analysis of the energy exchange process in human's organism an imitative hydrodynamic model was designed, which takes into account the property of an inertness of the biosystem. Using mathematics analyze methods and hydrodynamics bases the system of the nonlinear differential equations subscribing the functional of entrances and exits of model was obtained. With this model an appropriate software can be written to realise the computer simulation model at different initial conditions and modes.

articleTitle: Use of physical knowledge for automation of the initial stages of designing
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2002 IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICAIS 2002)
abstract: The designing of new high-end technical objects on the basis of new, original principles of action, becomes a more and more important design direction, which gives large economic benefits. The quality of decisions taken at the initial stages of design largely depends on the amount and quality of the physical information used. In the paper the analysis of the known techniques of physical knowledge application in design are considered. Also one of the most perspective approaches based on the automatic synthesis of structures of physical principles of operation is introduced. PPO is a structure reflecting some interrelations of physical effects and phenomena, which are resulting, in their own interaction, in the execution of the user-defined function. The fund, containing more than 1200 structured descriptions of physical effects, applies to synthesis support. The fund efficiency for information support of the design process is shown.

articleTitle: NeuroFAST: high accuracy neuro-fuzzy modeling
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2002 IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICAIS 2002)
abstract: Most fuzzy modeling algorithms rely either on simplistic (grid type) or off-line (trial-and-error type) structure identification methods. The proposed neurofuzzy modeling architecture, NeuroFAST, is an on-line, structure and parameter learning algorithm, featuring high function approximation accuracy. It is based on the first order Takagi-Sugeno-Kang (TSK) model (functional reasoning), where the consequence part of each fuzzy rule is a linear equation of the input variables. Fuzzy rules are allocated as learning evolves by a modified Fuzzy ART (Adaptive Resonance Theory) mechanism, assisted by fuzzy rule splitting and adding procedures (structure learning). The well known /spl delta/-rule continuously tunes learning weights on both premise and consequence parts (parameter identification). Tested on the Box-Jenkins gas furnace process modeling and the Mackey-Glass chaotic time series prediction, NeuroFAST yields very good results in terms of approximation accuracy, outperforming all known approaches.

abstract: Presents the front cover of the proceedings record.

publicationTitle: Proceedings 2002 IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICAIS 2002)
abstract: The author index contains an entry for each author and coauthor included in the proceedings record.
